query: How do finite-element models predict performance and failure modes of horn-backed laminated bows versus wooden longbows under realistic draw lengths and moisture cycles?

response.query: How do finite-element models predict performance and failure modes of horn-backed laminated bows versus wooden longbows under realistic draw lengths and moisture cycles?
response.answer: Finite-element models predict horn-backed laminated bows outperform wooden longbows under realistic draw lengths and moisture cycles due to better stress distribution and durability. Failure modes differ, with laminated bows showing less warping and cracking.
